metrics_finding.finding: The search-service experienced a significant increase in CPU utilization, memory utilization, and mean latency during the failure window.

evidence_summary.summary: The search-service experienced a significant increase in CPU utilization, memory utilization, and mean latency during the failure window.

report.suggested_fix: Investigate and optimize the search-service to reduce CPU utilization, memory utilization, and mean latency.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to the search-service. Further investigation is required to confirm this hypothesis.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के मुख्य कारण सूची सेवा संभावित रूप से जुड़ा हुआ है। अतिरिक्त विश्लेषण आवश्यक है ताकि यह सिद्ध किया जा सके।
